title: Workforce Skill meta.json
description: Workforce-specific operational metadata that lives alongside SKILL.md. Kept as a sidecar so SKILL.md stays portable to claude.ai / the Claude Agent Skills API.

name.description: Skill name. Must equal SKILL.md:name and the directory name.

version.description: Semver. Bumped on Rule-11 SKILL.md body PRs. First version is 0.1.0.

trigger_class.description: Where the Skill's scripts/ can actually execute. 'lambda' Skills are prompt-only at v1; 'webhook' adds a runner-side POST step after the LLM call (e.g. Discord notification).

cost_class.description: Projected per-invocation cost. small ~$0.05, medium ~$0.20, large ~$0.60.

owners.description: Agent slugs allowed to invoke this Skill. Cross-checked against workforce/agents/.

improvement_agent.description: Agent slug assigned to improve this Skill (RFC-009 placeholder). null until that RFC lands.

inputs.description: Symbolic input slot names; informational at v1.

outputs.description: Symbolic output slot names; informational at v1.

created_at.description: ISO date. Set on first PR; never edited.

deprecated_replacement.description: When status=deprecated, the slug of the Skill that supersedes this one.
